name: swift-lsp
description: SourceKit-LSP (xcrun sourcekit-lsp) MCP bridge, multi-file swiftc -dump-ast sandbox fallback, and SDK interface inspector for Swift 6, macOS 27.2+, and iOS 27.2+ development in Antigravity App and CLI. Provides symbol-anchored hover, definition, references, workspace symbols, dual-platform (macOS + iOS simulator) live diagnostics, and direct Xcode .swiftinterface lookup without cold-build or sandbox overhead.
